title: HR Technology Director
description: <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Director, HR Technology &amp; Solutions Delivery is a senior technology leadership role responsible for the strategy, design, delivery, operation and evolution of Inizio's global HR technology ecosystem.</p> <p>In the near term, the role has significant accountability for Workday, leading day-to-day IT operations, functional solution design, enhancements, continuous improvement and strategic HR technology projects.</p> <p>Over time, the role will evolve HR Technology towards a stronger platform engineering and architecture-led model, establishing the technical strategy, engineering practices, integration architecture, governance, security and operational capabilities required to support Inizio at scale.</p> <p>This requires a leader who can operate across both the functional and technical dimensions of Workday – translating HR requirements into effective solutions while bringing the technical depth and engineering mindset to shape the future HR technology landscape.</p> <p>You will have end-to-end IT accountability for Workday and the wider HR technology ecosystem. The Workday IT Operations team will report directly to this role, which reports to the Deputy Chief Information Officer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Workday Platform, Operations &amp; Functional Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide end-to-end IT ownership of Workday, covering functional design, configuration, operations, support, enhancements and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Partner with HR People Services and Centres of Excellence to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Workday solutions aligned with global standards.</li> <li>Provide senior oversight of Workday business processes, configuration, security, reporting, integrations and adoption of new platform capabilities.</li> <li>Lead the Workday IT Operations team, ensuring effective management of incidents, requests, defects, changes, enhancements and releases.</li> <li>Establish effective service levels, operational KPIs, demand and backlog management, root-cause analysis, testing, documentation and operational controls.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement, automation and proactive platform management to improve user experience, reliability and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Act as the senior escalation and decision point for significant Workday functional, technical and operational matters.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>HR Technology Project &amp; Solutions Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>HR Technology Strategy: Own end-to-end technology delivery of significant Workday and wider HR technology initiatives, from requirements and solution design through build, integration, testing, deployment, stabilisation and BAU transition.</li> <li>Lead Workday enhancements, module implementations, optimisation initiatives and HR transformation projects.</li> <li>Ensure solutions align with business outcomes, architecture principles and the longer-term HR technology roadmap.</li> <li>Establish delivery governance across scope, plans, dependencies, resources, risks, quality and budget.</li> <li>Hold systems integrators and delivery partners accountable for delivery, solution quality, knowledge transfer and sustainable support.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Architecture &amp; Engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define the technology strategy, target architecture and multi-year roadmap for Inizio's global HR technology ecosystem.</li> <li>Establish architecture and engineering principles across platforms, integrations, APIs, data, identity, security, environments, testing, deployment, monitoring and operational resilience.</li> <li>Lead the progressive evolution of HR Technology towards a stronger platform engineering operating model, increasing automation, standardisation and engineering discipline.</li> <li>Ensure HR technology is scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable and aligned with Inizio's wider enterprise technology strategy.</li> <li>Manage technical debt and identify opportunities to simplify and modernise the HR technology estate.</li> <li>Develop internal technical capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners for core platform knowledge.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Integrations, Security &amp; Technical Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own technical governance across HR technology architecture, integrations, security and change.</li> <li>Ensure secure and reliable connectivity between Workday, HR applications, enterprise platforms, identity services, data platforms and external providers.</li> <li>Establish appropriate integration patterns, APIs, middleware and data standards, reducing unnecessary point-to-point connectivity.</li> <li>Ensure appropriate controls across cyber security, data privacy, identity and access management, privileged access, segregation of duties and change management.</li> <li>Embed security, risk and compliance requirements into solution design and delivery and maintain appropriate controls and audit evidence.</li> <li>Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Data and Integration teams to ensure HR technology aligns with enterprise standards.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Vendor, Commercial &amp; HR Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the senior IT partner to HR leadership, translating HR strategy and operational priorities into an actionable technology roadmap.</li> <li>Work with HR People Services and Centres of Excellence to shape solutions and prioritise BAU enhancements, projects and strategic investments.</li> <li>Provide guidance on Workday capabilities and wider opportunities including automation, AI and emerging HR technologies.</li> <li>Manage strategic relationships with Workday, technology vendors, systems integrators and specialist partners.</li> <li>Hold partners accountable for technical capability, solution quality, service, delivery and commercial outcomes and provide technology leadership for vendor selection and investment decisions.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; Capability Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and lead a high-performing HR Technology team with the right balance of Workday functional, technical, integration, engineering and operational capabilities.</li> <li>Develop the technical maturity of the function through coaching, standards and strong engineering practices.</li> <li>Foster collaboration across HR, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Data, Integration and wider IT.</li> <li>Establish a culture of ownership, customer focus, engineering quality, accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Act as a visible and credible senior technology leader across the organisation.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <p>You are an experienced HR technology leader who combines strong Workday functional and delivery expertise with technical depth and an engineering mindset.</p> <p>You understand how Workday supports end-to-end HR processes and can lead functional solution design and delivery, while being equally comfortable discussing integrations, architecture, security, engineering and enterprise technology.</p> <p>You will bring:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading Workday in a complex enterprise environment across functional design, BAU operations, enhancements and project delivery.</li> <li>Strong Workday functional solution-design expertise across multiple areas, with an understanding of HCM processes, configuration, security, reporting, integrations and data.</li> <li>Proven experience delivering significant Workday implementations, module deployments, transformations or optimisation programmes.</li> <li>Strong understanding of enterprise integrations, APIs, middleware, data integration and connectivity.</li> <li>Understanding of platform engineering practices including testing, deployment, monitoring, automation and operational resilience.</li> <li>Strong understanding of application security, identity and access management, technology risk, data privacy and change controls.</li> <li>Experience establishing effective technical and functional governance for enterprise applications.</li> <li>Demonstrated success managing systems integrators, vendors and strategic partners.</li> <li>Experience building and leading multidisciplinary technology teams.</li> <li>Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across HR and Technology leadership.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Critically, you will be comfortable operating across the full spectrum from Workday functional design and day-to-day platform decisions through to enterprise architecture and technology strategy.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Desirable</p> <ul> <li>Senior Manager, Director or equivalent experience within a global organisation.</li> <li>Deep experience across Workday HCM and multiple Workday modules, supported by Workday certifications and/or demonstrable functional and technical expertise.</li> <li>Experience leading global Workday deployments, optimisation programmes or major HR transformations.</li> <li>Experience within consulting, technology, pharmaceutical, life sciences or another complex multinational environment.</li> <li>Experience introducing platform engineering, DevOps, automation or product-oriented ways of working into enterprise applications.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Inizio</strong></p> <p>At Inizio, we're a global team motivated by a shared purpose: to reimagine health.</p> <p>Formed in 2022, we unite decades of experience and expertise with data, technology, and AI to create tailored solutions that drive Intelligent Commercialization™ at every stage of the journey - from discovery to post-launch.</p> <p>Our global network of over 10,000 experts operates across 50 countries, supporting clients with strategic insight, medical excellence, creative engagement, and real-world delivery. We work with the world's leading health and life sciences businesses to solve complex challenges and accomplish meaningful outcomes for our clients and patients.</p> <p>What sets Inizio apart is our people - and we believe everyone should excel. Here, you're encouraged to reimagine your possibilities: to grow, to be curious and to make change happen. We value your individuality, support your development, and celebrate your ambition. If you're ready to push boundaries and accelerate your career, Inizio is the best place to be.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Pledge</strong></p> <p>At Inizio, we value inclusivity, recognize the power of diversity and inspire the next generation of change-makers. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity, equity and inclusion. We aim to recruit from a diverse slate of candidates and foster an environment that provides the right conditions for long-term success. We welcome all applications. We consider them regardless of race, color, religion, or belief. We also consider them regardless of gender, gender identity, age, national origin, marital status, military veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, and physical or mental disability.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Artificial Intelligence</strong></p> <p>Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions at Inizio are made by our human recruiting team. We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-DT2 #LI-HYBRID</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="elementToProof"><em>Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.</em></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: SEO Executive - Graduate / Junior
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p>Team:&nbsp;Search &amp; Social (Commerce Division), THG Ingenuity</p> <p><strong>Introduction</strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a leading ecommerce and technology business, powering some of the world's most recognised brands. Our Search &amp; Social team sits within the wider Commerce division, operating at the intersection of ecommerce, marketing, and commercial strategy. Alongside our Content and Paid Media teams, we connect brands with customers through world-class organic and paid search strategies.</p> <p>We're looking for an ambitious, detail-oriented graduate to join our team and help shape the future of search. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a passion for SEO to build a career at the forefront of digital marketing, working on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-driven search within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</p> <p>Success in this role requires a deep curiosity for search engine algorithms, strong analytical skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to build positive relationships with internal teams (like eCommerce, Paid Media, and project management) and external brand clients.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As an SEO &amp; GEO Executive, you will support the planning, execution, optimisation, and reporting of organic search campaigns across multiple brands. You will work to grow organic visibility, traffic, and revenue, ensuring our clients dominate the search engine results pages (SERPs).</p> <p>You'll work in close partnership with our Paid Media team to ensure our organic and paid search strategies are fully aligned. You'll also collaborate daily with the eCommerce teams who are trading the sites, project teams managing site onboards, and external brand partners, ensuring SEO is a core pillar of our commercial success.</p> <p>This role combines technical SEO, content strategy, performance analysis, and stakeholder management, providing a well-rounded foundation in the future of search.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the end-to-end delivery of SEO strategies for multiple brands.</li> <li>Conduct keyword research, content gap analysis, and SERP analysis to identify new growth opportunities.</li> <li>Perform technical SEO audits to identify and fix issues related to site architecture, crawlability, and indexation.</li> <li>Collaborate with content teams to ensure on-page content is optimised for both users and search engines.</li> <li>Analyse and report on organic performance using Google Search Console, GA4, and industry-standard search analytics platforms.</li> <li>Work closely with the Paid Media team to share search query insights, coordinate keyword targeting, and develop a unified search strategy.</li> <li>Support project teams with SEO requirements for site migrations and new client onboards.</li> <li>Stay informed on algorithm updates, competitor activity, and emerging trends, particularly in AI-driven search and GEO.</li> <li>Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders (eCommerce, Content, Paid Media) and external brand clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You</strong></p> <p>We're looking for someone who is:</p> <ul> <li>A recent graduate with a primary passion for SEO and organic search, and a keen interest in related fields like Paid Media, eCommerce, client services, or digital marketing.</li> <li>Highly organised with strong time management and prioritisation skills.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with exceptionally high standards of accuracy and quality.</li> <li>Commercially aware and interested in how SEO drives business performance.</li> <li>A strong communicator with excellent written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Professional, collaborative and able to build positive stakeholder relationships with both internal teams and external clients.</li> <li>Proactive, accountable and comfortable taking ownership of their work.</li> <li>Curious, adaptable and eager to learn about the future of search.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></p> <p>Essential</p> <ul> <li>A foundational understanding of SEO principles (technical, on-page, and off-page).</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail.</li> <li>Strong written communication skills, including grammar and spelling.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.</li> <li>A genuine appetite and eagerness to learn and develop.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Some hands-on experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics (GA4).</li> <li>Familiarity with web crawling or search analytics platforms.</li> <li>Understanding of the relationship between SEO and other digital marketing channels like Paid Media, Content, and eCommerce.</li> <li>Experience working in a fast-paced, commercial environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse &amp; inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.

Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact on your own development, on Deliveroo as we scale, and on the marketplace and communities we serve.

Consumer Ordering Experience owns the core purchase journey: the store page, item page, basket, and checkout flow, across both app and web. It's a global team — the surfaces we build support all of our brands: Deliveroo, Wolt, and Doordash. You'd be the team's first dedicated web/full-stack engineer, helping us build out our web experience from the ground up.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve the store, item, basket, and checkout experiences on web, working primarily in React and TypeScript
  • Contribute to backend services written in Golang — deep Go experience isn't a hard requirement, but you should be comfortable picking up a new statically typed backend language
  • Improve code structure, shape architecture, and review code across the team
  • Partner closely with your Product Manager and fellow engineers to scope and ship changes to the ordering funnel
  • Take part in the hiring process and support the growth of your teammates as the team scales

 

What We're Looking For

Must haves:

  • Strong full-stack experience — comfortable working across web frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go, or similar) to unblock delivery end-to-end
  • Experience designing, implementing and rolling out A/B experiments (or strong aptitude to quickly learn our experimentation platform) — including guardrail metrics, staged rollouts and reading results
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities and short XP cycles (weeks, not quarters)
  • Strong ownership mindset — able to take a brief PRD through design, implementation, rollout and production monitoring with minimal hand-holding
  • Track record of shipping incrementally and iterating on data rather than big-bang launches
  • Willing to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to incidents

 

Nice to haves:

  • Experience coordinating engineers across multiple platforms (iOS/Android/Web/BE) on a single initiative
  • Active use of AI-assisted coding workflows, and interest in building reusable tooling/skills for the team

 

We're looking for someone London-based who can work from our office 2–3 days a week alongside the rest of the team.

 

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing. You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset. Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing. 🚀 What you'll own Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members. Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team. Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on. Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time. Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers. Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team. Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows. Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets. Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process. Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution. Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation. Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control. Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation. Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support. Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus. CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion. Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team. Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them. Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration. A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time. Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote. ⭐️ Bonus points Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in. Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures. Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows. Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness). Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations. title: Senior Account Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the team:</strong></p> <p>As Senior Account Manager, you'll be a senior individual contributor and a cornerstone of our commercial team. You'll own an above-average revenue target and be expected to consistently deliver, and exceed, it. Operating with a high degree of autonomy; you'll manage complex, high-value deals end-to-end, drive forecast accuracy, and actively shape how we go to market. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic influence: you'll be as comfortable building a Looker report as you are leading a high-stakes negotiation, and as effective with Finance and Product as you are in front of a customer.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and grow a portfolio of key accounts, consistently exceeding revenue targets and carrying above-average quota.</li> <li>Maintain accurate pipeline and revenue forecasts, surfacing risks proactively and identifying in-quarter opportunities to accelerate attainment.</li> <li>Lead complex, high-value negotiations; adapting style to different stakeholders and closing with minimal concessions.</li> <li>Build and tailor compelling value propositions, running multi-channel outreach to fill and advance pipeline efficiently.</li> <li>Manage multiple concurrent work-streams with clear ownership, balancing scope, time, and quality with minimal oversight.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to deliver solutions and influence roadmap priorities based on customer feedback.</li> <li>Analyse multi-dimensional data in Looker, AI and Google Sheets to surface actionable insights and build compelling, decision-driving narratives.</li> <li>Coach junior team members and contribute to a culture of proactive, well-received feedback.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in digital advertising, account management, or consultative sales; preferably within mobile or programmatic ad-tech.</li> <li>Strong forecasting discipline and pipeline management skills, with experience running high-value deals from prospecting through close.</li> <li>Skilled negotiator who adapts approach intuitively and is comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.</li> <li>Proficient in Looker, AI and Google Sheets, with the ability to analyse complex data sets and build clear, impactful visualisations independently.</li> <li>Excellent cross-functional collaborator, with experience engaging Product, Finance, and Marketing beyond immediate deal needs.</li> <li>High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and the ability to give and receive feedback constructively.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree; advanced degree a plus.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 10% for client meetings and industry events.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>Travel Expectations:</strong></p> <p>We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>:</p> <p>Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.</p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p><strong>Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director/Senior Director, Molecular Discovery
description: <p><strong>Your Impact at LILA</strong></p> <p>The Director, Molecular Discovery is responsible for ensuring our autonomous science platform reliably and repeatedly delivers validated small-molecule drug candidates against designated targets at increasing speed. The platform generates and tests hypotheses at superhuman scale, and you ensure that process translates into real, high-quality compounds that advance toward the clinic.</p> <p>This role leans heavily into the AI and computational side of our workflow: you will be accountable for throughput, quality, and the operational health of the discovery engine, working hand-in-hand with AI scientists, computational chemists, and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks, close feedback loops, and continuously improve how the platform performs.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own small molecule discovery programs against assigned targets, from hit identification through lead optimization and candidate nomination.</li> <li>Serve as the accountable leader for discovery output setting and hitting timelines, quality benchmarks, and throughput targets across active programs.</li> <li>Operate as the primary interface between the autonomous science platform and drug discovery decision-making, ensuring that what the platform produces meets the bar for potency, selectivity, ADMET properties, and developability.</li> <li>Collaborate daily with AI/ML, robotics, and software engineering teams to close the loop between computational predictions and experimental results, driving continuous improvement of the platform's predictive accuracy and experimental efficiency.</li> <li>Architect the components of each discovery program end to end, specifying the required assays, building or sourcing the right capabilities, and managing the scientific staff needed to execute. Define and enforce the quality standards, assay cascades, and decision criteria that govern how compounds progress through the pipeline.</li> <li>Facilitate relationships with CROs and external partners for specialized studies (e.g., in vivo pharmacology, safety pharmacology, DMPK) that sit outside the automated platform.</li> <li>Provide drug discovery expertise to Lila's product team for commercial partnerships, translating platform capabilities into credible value propositions for pharma and biotech collaborators.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Succeed</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ph.D. in medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, or a closely related discipline.</li> <li>12+ years of experience in small molecule drug discovery from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side with at least 5 years in a senior role closely involved in advancing compounds from hit-to-lead through candidate selection.</li> <li>Demonstrated involvement in programs that delivered clinical candidates, with enough proximity to compound progression decisions to own them whether from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side.</li> <li>Deep fluency in medicinal chemistry principles, you may not have practiced bench medchem, but you understand SAR, synthetic tractability, and the multiparameter tradeoffs at the core of lead optimization (potency, selectivity, ADMET, PK, safety) well enough to guide them or define systematic decision frameworks for them.</li> <li>Operational mindset, experience running discovery programs with clear metrics, milestones, and accountability structures, and a comfort level with managing throughput and efficiency alongside scientific quality.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of ADMET, DMPK, and the data packages required to advance a candidate to IND-enabling studies.</li> <li>Fluency with AI/ML-driven molecular design approaches (generative chemistry, molecular property prediction, free energy methods, active learning) and the practical judgment to know when computational output is actionable and when it needs experimental validation. You don’t need to build models, but you must be a credible, hands-on collaborator with the scientists who do.</li> <li>Effective communicator who can translate complex scientific and operational status into clear updates for leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct experience with automated, high-throughput, or closed-loop discovery environments (e.g., self-driving labs, robotic synthesis and screening platforms), you've seen what it takes to make these systems produce real drug discovery output, not just proof-of-concept demos.</li> <li>Experience applying computational chemistry or cheminformatics in a hands-on capacity, not just consuming model outputs, but contributing to how molecular design hypotheses are generated, scored, and prioritized.</li> <li>Experience building or scaling a discovery operation from early stage, standing up assay cascades, workflows, team structures, and vendor relationships without inheriting a mature infrastructure.</li> <li>Background across multiple therapeutic areas, giving you breadth in target biology and the flexibility to work across a diverse portfolio.</li> <li>Process-oriented thinking: you instinctively look for ways to measure, standardize, and improve how work gets done, without letting process become bureaucracy.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.</p> <p><strong>U.S. Benefits.</strong> Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.</p> <p><strong>International Benefits.</strong> Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.</p></div><div class="title">Expected Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$202,400</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$323,400 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About LILA</strong></p> <p>Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.</p> <p>LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.</p> <p>Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>We’re All In</strong></p> <p>Lila Sciences is&nbsp;committed to equal employment opportunity&nbsp;regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.</p> <p>Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our <a href="https://www.lila.ai/candidate-privacy-policy-notice">Candidate Privacy Policy</a>.</p> <p><strong>A Note to Agencies</strong></p> <p><em>Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About Augur Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate – not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design. Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights – all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots. Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products – it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence. We're looking for a Robotics Engineer to join our growing technical team in London and take ownership of the integration of a new counter-UAS initiative. This role sits at the intersection of robotics, machine learning and systems engineering, and you'll own the integration across all three. You'll prove out the concept, build the prototype, and take it into trials, working closely with product partners and other stakeholders along the way. The role is highly interdisciplinary, so we're less concerned with ticking every box than with finding someone motivated, curious, and willing to learn. Across the project, you'll draw on areas such as: Machine learning and computer vision Sensors and camera modelling State estimation and sensor fusion Control theory Modelling and simulation Low-level programming and hardware/software integration We don't expect you to be an expert in all of these. If you're strong in some and excited to grow into the rest, we'd like to hear from you. What We're Looking For A degree in robotics, electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics or a related field - or another engineering background backed by hands-on hardware/software integration work. Strong programming skills in a low-level language (C, C++ or Rust), plus Python. A working understanding of modern computer vision, including object detection and tracking, and experience training, optimising, and deploying models for real-time or resource-constrained use. Hands-on experience with state estimation and sensor fusion - using techniques such as Kalman filtering and factor graphs to combine noisy sensor data into reliable estimates - and with the problems they underpin, such as SLAM. A solid grasp of sensors and how to model them: you understand how real sensors behave, particularly cameras, and can represent them with appropriate models (e.g. camera and distortion models). Self-directed initiative: you can take an unfamiliar problem, get up to speed through your own research, and clearly document and share your findings so others can build on them. Strong communication skills: you can explain technical work clearly and work effectively with external partners and suppliers. Nice to Have A working knowledge of control theory, particularly designing and tuning PID controllers for closed-loop systems. Experience developing and testing systems before committing to hardware, from numerical modelling through to 3D simulation. Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate – not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design.

Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights – all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots.

Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products – it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence.

We're looking for a Robotics Engineer to join our growing technical team in London and take ownership of the integration of a new counter-UAS initiative.

 

This role sits at the intersection of robotics, machine learning and systems engineering, and you'll own the integration across all three. You'll prove out the concept, build the prototype, and take it into trials, working closely with product partners and other stakeholders along the way.

 

The role is highly interdisciplinary, so we're less concerned with ticking every box than with finding someone motivated, curious, and willing to learn. Across the project, you'll draw on areas such as:

 

  • Machine learning and computer vision

  • Sensors and camera modelling

  • State estimation and sensor fusion

  • Control theory

  • Modelling and simulation

  • Low-level programming and hardware/software integration

 

We don't expect you to be an expert in all of these. If you're strong in some and excited to grow into the rest, we'd like to hear from you.

 

What We're Looking For

 

  • A degree in robotics, electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics or a related field - or another engineering background backed by hands-on hardware/software integration work.

  • Strong programming skills in a low-level language (C, C++ or Rust), plus Python.

  • A working understanding of modern computer vision, including object detection and tracking, and experience training, optimising, and deploying models for real-time or resource-constrained use.

  • Hands-on experience with state estimation and sensor fusion - using techniques such as Kalman filtering and factor graphs to combine noisy sensor data into reliable estimates - and with the problems they underpin, such as SLAM.

  • A solid grasp of sensors and how to model them: you understand how real sensors behave, particularly cameras, and can represent them with appropriate models (e.g. camera and distortion models).

  • Self-directed initiative: you can take an unfamiliar problem, get up to speed through your own research, and clearly document and share your findings so others can build on them.

  • Strong communication skills: you can explain technical work clearly and work effectively with external partners and suppliers.

 
 

Nice to Have

 

  • A working knowledge of control theory, particularly designing and tuning PID controllers for closed-loop systems.

  • Experience developing and testing systems before committing to hardware, from numerical modelling through to 3D simulation.

  • Familiarity with RF and RF-based sensing, including how RF sensors and sensor arrays work.

Accessibility and inclusivity

  • Run a monthly and quarterly P&L reforecast cycle covering opex, capex, headcount, and cash runway, with clear bridges to the prior forecast

  • Produce consolidated cash and burn reporting for the VP of Accounting, CFO, board, and investors, and manage runway scenarios against the funding plan

  • Deliver monthly actuals-vs-forecast and actuals-vs-budget variance analysis at entity, department, and project level, with root-cause commentary

  • Build and maintain the group's operating and financial model on a US GAAP basis, consistent with the group's technical accounting positions (capitalization policy, ASC 842 lease accounting, project-finance debt, share-based compensation)

  • Model the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow impacts of major transactions: site acquisitions, colocation and lease commitments, GPU financing, debt drawdowns, and equity events

  • Establish variance thresholds, escalation routes, and reporting formats that will stand up as SOX-adjacent management review controls

  • Define the FP&A calendar, templates, and data model, and contribute to ERP design during the NetSuite implementation

What You Bring

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), or equivalent depth in US GAAP-based modeling — this role requires genuine accounting fluency, not just spreadsheet fluency

  • Experience in multi-entity, multi-currency groups; comfort with intercompany flows and FX in forecasting

  • Strong grasp of accrual accounting mechanics: able to build a three-statement model that ties to the trial balance and explain timing versus rate versus volume variances

  • Comfort with ambiguity and zero-to-one process building; you write clearly and present numbers that go to the board without rework

Across every team, you will translate three key inputs into durable platform capabilities: product roadmap requirements from the product team, operational learnings from the bring-up teams, and security guidance from the security engineering team. The output of this role is production platform code, not configuration, not runbooks.

 

What You Will Be Doing

Common across every platform engineering team:

  • Design and implement Kubernetes operators and controllers that manage the lifecycle of platform resources.

  • Work closely with the product team to turn roadmap requirements into the platform capabilities that support them.

  • Collaborate with the bring-up teams to identify operational pain points and turn them into scalable platform features.

  • Integrate security guidance from the security engineering team into platform-level controls, and remediate findings at the platform layer.

  • Treat observability as a platform concern: instrument services, define meaningful metrics, and build tooling that gives the team visibility into platform health.

  • Own the services you build in production, including participation in an on-call rotation, incident response, and the follow-up work that closes structural gaps rather than only the immediate issue.

  • Hold to clean interface and versioning practice on anything other teams or customers depend on, including disciplined handling of breaking changes.

  • Participate in code review, technical design discussions, and cross-team collaboration in an Agile (Kanban or Scrum) environment.

Depending on your team and background, you will go deep in some of the following:

  • Control plane and APIs: improve and extend the API layer between user-facing services and the underlying platform, with disciplined versioning and backward compatibility.

  • Compute: build and operate the lifecycle of virtualized and bare metal compute resources.

  • Storage: provisioning workflows, attachment reliability, performance tuning, and failure handling.

  • Confidential computing: build and extend confidential computing capabilities across the stack, from secure bare metal and confidential VMs to Confidential Containers (CoCo).

  • Customer-facing services: the platform surfaces customers interact with directly, including the APIs and interfaces through which they consume capacity, working alongside product and UX.

 

What You Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of software engineering experience, with a meaningful portion spent on infrastructure or platform systems.

  • Strong backend or systems programming experience in a production environment. Our working languages are Python, Go, and Rust; we welcome strong engineers from other compiled or object-oriented languages (for example C++, C#, or Java) who are ready to work across our stack as it evolves.

  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes internals: the control loop model, CRDs, controllers and operators, and reliable reconciliation logic.

  • Comfortable working close to the infrastructure layer: Linux, networking fundamentals, and distributed systems behavior.

  • Experience designing, building, and versioning production-grade APIs or service interfaces that other teams depend on, including disciplined handling of breaking changes and backward compatibility.

  • Experience operating what you build: debugging production systems, and taking part in on-call or incident response.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals: clean code, testing, version control, code review, and CI/CD practices.

Nice to Have (But Not Essential)

  • Fluency with AI-assisted development: agentic CLI tools, IDE assistants, and orchestrating multiple coding agents through MCP, skills, or APIs to amplify delivery.

  • Depth in Go or Rust beyond working proficiency.

  • Familiarity with confidential computing technologies: TEEs, AMD SEV, Intel TDX, or Confidential Containers (CoCo).

  • Experience integrating security requirements into platform or infrastructure systems.

  • Familiarity with high-performance networking: overlay protocols, BGP, RDMA, or packet-processing frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience with distributed storage systems (Ceph or similar) at an engineering level.

  • Background building Kubernetes operators using frameworks such as Kopf, controller-runtime, or similar.

  • Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or structured logging in distributed systems.

  • Experience building SaaS or PaaS layers on top of an IaaS platform.

En tant que <strong>Recruteur / Recruteuse Supply Chain &amp; Opérations</strong>, tu joueras un rôle clé dans cette expansion en recrutant les leaders qui construiront et feront grandir nos nouveaux sites logistiques.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Ton périmètre couvre des postes clés pour nos opérations : superviseurs, chefs d’équipe, ingénieurs projets et responsables de sites. Tu travailleras au plus près de nos équipes opérationnelles et de nos Hiring Managers, en comprenant leurs enjeux, en construisant les stratégies de recrutement adaptées et en identifiant les profils capables de faire grandir Picnic.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Chez Picnic, le recrutement ne consiste pas simplement à remplir des postes. Nous voulons construire des équipes solides et durables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur les talents que nous recrutons. Tu auras donc une vraie autonomie sur tes recrutements : tu définiras tes priorités, piloteras tes pipelines et challengeras les approches lorsque cela sera nécessaire pour atteindre tes objectifs sans faire de compromis sur la qualité.</p> <p>Tu seras également un véritable partenaire du business : tes Hiring Managers sont directement impliqués dans le recrutement et considèrent la construction de leur équipe comme une priorité. Ton rôle sera de leur apporter ton expertise recrutement, de faciliter les prises de décision et de les conseiller tout au long du processus.</p> <h2><strong>Tes missions</strong></h2> <p></p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Piloter tes recrutements de A à Z</strong> : tu prends en charge tes recrutements, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la signature, et construis les pipelines nécessaires pour atteindre tes objectifs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Accompagner notre expansion en France</strong> : tu recrutes les profils clés qui permettront l’ouverture et le développement de nos nouveaux sites logistiques.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Définir ta stratégie de recrutement</strong> : tu identifies les bons profils, marchés et canaux de sourcing, et adaptes ton approche en fonction de tes résultats.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Être un partenaire du business</strong> : tu travailles main dans la main avec tes Hiring Managers, les conseilles sur leurs recrutements et les challenges lorsque nécessaire.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Maintenir un haut niveau d’exigence</strong> : tu évalues les candidats avec rigueur et veilles à construire des équipes solides et durables.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>À propos de toi</strong></h2> <p></p> <ul> <li>Tu as <strong>2 à 5 ans d’expérience en recrutement</strong>, idéalement dans un environnement à forte croissance ou en évolution rapide.</li> <li>Tu sais <strong>prendre des décisions en autonomie</strong> et construire une stratégie de recrutement pour atteindre tes objectifs.</li> <li>Tu es à l’aise pour <strong>conseiller et challenger tes Hiring Managers</strong>, tout en construisant une relation de confiance avec eux.</li> <li>Tu accordes beaucoup d’importance à la <strong>qualité des recrutements</strong> et sais maintenir un niveau d’exigence élevé.</li> <li>Tu es structuré.e, organisé.e et capable de gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités en parallèle.</li> <li>Tu maîtrises parfaitement <strong>le français et l’anglais</strong>, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.</li> <li>Tu es diplômé.e d’un <strong>Master</strong> en commerce, ressources humaines, psychologie ou dans un domaine similaire.</li> <li>Chez Picnic, nous utilisons <strong>Greenhouse</strong> comme ATS. C’est un plus si tu le connais déjà, mais pas indispensable.</li> </ul> <p></p> <h2><strong>Avantages Picnic</strong></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="perks-content">🍴&nbsp;<strong>Restauration&nbsp;</strong></p> <p class="perks-content">Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux restaurants du coin. Notre petite cuisine est également équipée de savoureux en-cas et rafraîchissements.</p> <p class="perks-content">🚲&nbsp;<strong>Santé et transports</strong></p> <p class="perks-content">Grâce à nos partenariats avec Sidecare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques. De plus, si tu te rends au travail en transports en commun, nous te remboursons ton abonnement à hauteur de 50%.</p> <p class="perks-content">✍️&nbsp;<strong>Développement personnel et professionnel</strong></p> <p class="perks-content">Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à un environnement dynamique, jeune et international.</p> <p>🎫<strong>Sorties et divertissement</strong></p> <p>Profite d'un accès à des offres et avantages exclusifs via notre CSE et partenaire Swile (bons d'achats, places de concert, cinéma, et plus encore). Tu profiteras aussi d'inviations à tous nos événements récurrents comme notre très convoitée Summer Party !&nbsp;</p> <p class="perks-content">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="perks-content"><strong><em>Merci de soumettre votre candidature en anglais et de préparer un CV en anglais.</em></strong></h3> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description: <p>As a Senior Security Engineer within Application Security at Datadog, you will help secure emerging application architectures where established security patterns may not yet exist, including agentic applications, LLM-enabled products, protocol-driven tool use, and untrusted execution environments. You will establish and validate security models, requirements, and controls while partnering with product and platform teams to develop secure-by-default approaches. Your work will address evolving trust boundaries, agent identity, data access, tool permissions, and runtime behavior through threat modeling, security solutions, and practical implementation. You will have the opportunity to shape how Datadog safely supports new application paradigms and address emerging security risks before they become systemic.</p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define security models, requirements, and guardrails for emerging application architectures where established patterns are incomplete or do not yet exist.</li> <li>Design, implement, and validate practical security controls that reduce risk in emerging architectures and high-risk system behaviors.</li> <li>Shape how emerging systems authenticate, authorize actions, isolate workloads, and access data, applying least-privilege principles throughout.</li> <li>Partner with product, platform, Infrastructure Security, and other engineering teams to identify security gaps and embed secure-by-default requirements from early design through production.</li> <li>Lead threat modeling and security assessments for new and existing products, focusing on evolving threats, unfamiliar trust boundaries, and new interaction patterns.</li> <li>Prioritize and drive remediation of emerging security risks, including continuous security testing where it provides durable coverage, and refine security approaches as architectures and threats evolve.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering or development in a collaborative environment, with Go, Rust, or Python experience preferred.</li> <li>You have experience in security and/or infrastructure/platform engineering, with exposure to distributed systems, application platforms, or agent-based architectures.</li> <li>You have designed or implemented security controls within application infrastructure, such as authentication, authorization, API security, zero-trust networking, workload protection, sandboxing, or runtime hardening.</li> <li>You understand common application security vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques, including those relevant to LLM applications and agentic systems; familiarity with LLM frameworks and protocols such as MCP or A2A is a plus.</li> <li>You bring strong problem-solving skills and can work independently and collaboratively in ambiguous or rapidly evolving problem spaces.</li> <li>You have successfully driven security initiatives with engineering and leadership stakeholders and are committed to staying current with security practices, emerging technologies, and evolving threats.</li> </ul> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits and Growth:</strong></p> <ul> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)</li> <li>Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing</li> <li>Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li> <li>An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)</li> <li>Access to Inclusion Talks, our internal panel discussions</li> <li>Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+</li> <li>Competitive global benefits</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.</p></div><p>As we expand our product portfolio and global presence, our Sales team is hiring a Sales Engineer to act as the technical point of contact working in partnership with the Regional Sales Director to drive excellence in the region within the full sales cycle and beyond.</p> <p>If this sounds like you, read on. Familiarity with AI and Agentic AI concepts, including how AI agents can automate and orchestrate enterprise workflows across SAP and non-SAP environments. Self-driven, proactive, and results-oriented, with the flexibility to take on different roles as needed (outreach, marketing support, event representation). Experience selling to large corporations and enterprise-scale organizations. Proficiency in CRM and sales tools. Comfortable building and owning a personal portfolio of target companies from scratch. What We Offer Competitive base salary with uncapped commission. The chance to shape Neptune's growth in one of our most strategic markets, with real autonomy over your territory and industry focus. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.<br><br><span class="mark7dca3wrxy" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="" data-ogsbtc="" data-ogsbrc="" data-ogsbbc="" data-ogsblc="" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">LI</span>-<span class="markwlkzbmifw" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="" data-ogsbtc="" data-ogsbrc="" data-ogsbbc="" data-ogsblc="">Promoted</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

 

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié
