international), CVAE, C3S, and DAS2, in coordination with the Tax department</li> <li>Prepare balance sheet justifications, intercompany account reconciliations, and audit-ready files for statutory auditors</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>What You'll Bring to the Role</strong></h3> <p><strong>Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3 to 5 years of experience in general accounting</li> <li>Proven track record managing multi-entity and/or international accounting scopes</li> <li>Experience preparing regulatory tax filings and working with external auditors</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong command of general ledger accounting and month-end close processes</li> <li>Ability to manage intercompany transactions and foreign subsidiary accounts</li> <li>Payroll accounting and social charges compliance</li> <li>Tax compliance (VAT, CVAE, C3S)</li> <li>Rigorous, autonomous, and comfortable working in a fast-scaling environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>&nbsp;Tools Used</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Oracle Suite (ERP)</li> <li>AI-powered tools (including Dust)</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>&nbsp;Languages</strong></h3> <ul> <li>French: Full professional proficiency</li> <li>English: Full professional proficiency</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Compensation &amp; Contract</strong></h3> <p>This is a freelance / contractor engagement. Rate and terms are open to discussion based on experience and scope.</p> <h3><strong>Our Hiring Process</strong></h3> <p>We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.</p> <p>Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. title: Solutions Engineer | France | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h4><strong>The Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Solutions Engineering team are the customer facing product experts. The team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure that they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Solutions Engineering team is one of the primary routes of communication from our customers to the Product Management and Engineering teams.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">A Solutions Engineer is able to really listen to a prospect or customer, understand their requirements, ask the right questions to extract as much information as required and translate all that into a solution with Grafana Labs technology. They are the bridge between the highly technical engineering folks here at Grafana Labs, our customers and our Sales team.</span></p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Partnering with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision and strategy to customers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Owning the technical engagement with customers and help close complex opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill and credibility</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Delivering product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Effectively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide feedback on our products and the competitive landscape</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Driving product conversations based on need and problems with customers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Working with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles and create other public or private enablement material</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes you a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">3+ years of technical pre-sales experience</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Be open to various and complex assignments, this will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Must be located in France&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space is an advantage&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Experience with sales methodologies like MEDD(P)ICC is a plus</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Compensation &amp; Rewards&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In France, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is EUR 103,750 - EUR 128,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-Remote</span></span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range &amp; benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture -&nbsp;</strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> </div> <div><em>For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our <a href="https://grafana.com/legal/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>.&nbsp;</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Gestionnaire d'Images H/F
description: En tant que Gestionnaire d'Images H/F, vous rejoindrez notre équipe d'Opérations d'Imagerie dans le cadre d'un contrat à durée déterminée de 18 mois (CDD) et jouerez un rôle clé dans la gestion des activités d'imagerie pour des essais cliniques internationaux en oncologie. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires, vous veillerez à la collecte, au contrôle qualité, à la revue et à la réconciliation en temps voulu des données d'imagerie médicale tout en soutenant la réussite des projets. Basé à notre siège à Sophia Antipolis, vous contribuerez à des études innovantes qui font avancer la recherche médicale et améliorent les résultats des patients. Responsabilités Principales Gérer les activités d'imagerie pour un portefeuille assigné d'études cliniques. Créer et maintenir les Directives d'Acquisition d'Images et la documentation d'étude. Effectuer le contrôle qualité des images et coordonner les flux de revue d'images. Gérer la réconciliation des données, la résolution des requêtes et le suivi des projets. Surveiller les métriques opérationnelles et soutenir la priorisation des projets pour respecter les délais et les objectifs de qualité. Fournir des mises à jour sur l'état des projets aux membres seniors de l'équipe et aux parties prenantes. Garantir le respect des procédures internes, des normes de qualité et des meilleures pratiques de l'industrie. Contribuer aux améliorations de processus, aux initiatives de formation et à la gestion des écarts. Soutenir les activités interfonctionnelles et agir en tant que remplaçant pour les opérations d'équipe en cas de besoin. Formation Titulaire d'une licence ou équivalent en Technologie de Radiologie Médicale, Génie Biomédical, Sciences de la Vie ou un domaine scientifique connexe. Expérience Expérience en imagerie médicale, radiologie, radiothérapie, soins de santé ou un environnement connexe. Exposition à la recherche clinique, aux essais cliniques ou aux activités liées à l'imagerie est un avantage. Stages hospitaliers ou formation clinique également appréciés. Compétences Connaissance des modalités d'imagerie médicale et des flux de travail d'imagerie. Compréhension des normes de qualité en matière de soins de santé et des environnements de soins aux patients. Familiarité avec les Bonnes Pratiques Cliniques (BPC) est un plus. Compétences organisationnelles et de communication solides. Capacité à travailler en collaboration au sein d'équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales. Maîtrise professionnelle du français ; l'anglais est fortement souhaité. Median Technologies s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, de l'égalité des genres et de l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Chef de Projet Paid Media Senior (H/F)
description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Aujourd'hui présents dans plus de 10 marchés, avec une part internationale qui dépasse 50 % des ventes, nous construisons notre croissance avec rigueur, sans sacrifier l'âme de la marque. C'est dans ce contexte que nous cherchons un·e Chef·fe de Projet Paid Media Senior pour renforcer notre équipe média. Intégré·e à l'équipe Média, vous pilotez les campagnes paid social (Meta, Pinterest, TikTok…) et autres canaux sur un périmètre de marchés clés dans le développement international de Sézane. Vous êtes garant·e de la performance de A à Z : cadrage stratégique, mise en place opérationnelle, analyse et restitution des résultats. Vos missions Traduire les enjeux business en stratégie média. Acquisition, retargeting, notoriété, vous construisez les plans d'activation en cohérence avec le calendrier Sézane. Opérer les campagnes avec autonomie et exigence. Vous gérez de bout en bout les activations sur l'ensemble des plateformes sociales, en cherchant toujours le bon équilibre entre performance et cohérence de marque. Analyser, challenger, recommander. CPA, ROAS, COS, LTV, incrémentalité, vous lisez les chiffres avec recul et formulez des recommandations actionnables sur les audiences, créas et enchères. Embarquer les équipes avec des reportings orientés décision. Clairs, concis, au service du pilotage marketing et du management. Être force de proposition sur l'innovation média. Bêtas, nouveaux formats, évolutions des méthodologies de mesure , vous apportez un regard curieux et structuré sur ce qui peut faire avancer notre pratique. Contribuer au mix media global. En lien étroit avec les équipes e-merch, CRM et créa, vous participez à la réflexion sur nos choix d'investissement et nos modèles de mesure. Requirements 5 ans minimum d'expérience en gestion de campagnes paid social, en agence performance ou chez un e-commerçant. Maîtrise opérationnelle des plateformes d'achat media (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok for Business, Pinterest Ads…).  Solides compétences analytiques : à l'aise avec Excel (TCD, formules avancées) et idéalement avec un outil BI (Metabase, Looker, Tableau). Rigueur et autonomie : vous gérez vos priorités, respectez vos délais et alertez au bon moment. Curiosité et appétence pour la marque : vous comprenez que la performance média ne se lit pas sans le contexte produit et la saisonnalité.  Anglais professionnel indispensable (marchés internationaux). Benefits Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un contexte de croissance internationale réelle, avec des marchés aux enjeux différenciés Une équipe média interne, en lien direct avec les équipes e-merch, CRM et créa Des sujets de mesure et de pilotage automatisé ambitieux Une culture du travail fondée sur la confiance, l'autonomie et l'amélioration continue. About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK or Germany.

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

As a Computational Biologist at Owkin, you will have a unique opportunity to contribute to the discovery of better treatments through the development and use of agentic AI systems. An integral member of the Biomedical team, you will work alongside world-class experts in AI and biology within a multidisciplinary team dedicated to pioneering discoveries, all while embedded in an organization that develops end-to-end AI systems for clients. Your experience in omics will allow you to contribute to the building of our AI Scientist, an agentic system designed to navigate the complexities of target and drug discovery.

 

In particular, you will:

  • Contribute analyses to projects aiming to discover novel drug targets, biomarkers and disease subtypes through reverse translation based on multi-omics patient or pre-clinical data including: genomic, transcriptomic (spatial, single-cell, bulk), proteomic, and others.

  • analyze biomedical datasets using classical or novel omics methods and machine / deep learning algorithms

  • Conduct literature reviews to stay up-to-date with respect to relevant approaches and datasets

  • Participate in the interpretation of results and help design validation strategies together with cross-functional teams.

  • Collaborate with other members of Owkin’s R&Tech and Biomedical departments with varied backgrounds (computational biologists and chemists, AI scientists, medical imaging experts, medical doctors, biologists, …).

  • Contribute analyses and visualisations to generate scientific internal and external communications and reports.

  • Participate in Owkin’s internal R&D activities, develop new as well as improve existing methodologies, strive to keep Owkin’s Toolbox to the state-of-the-art.

  

About you

The successful candidate will have a ‘team-first’ kind of attitude; be curious and detail-attentive; thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment; and be fun to work with.

And:

  • Be passionate about the potential for impact when combining AI and healthcare.

  • MSc / PhD in either computational biology, bioinformatics, biology, machine learning, computer science, mathematics or a related field.

  • Experience working with omics data and NGS data processing pipelines.

  • Experience of integrating multi-omics datasets.

  • Experience of working in early-stage drug discovery programs, and with tasks such as target identification, biomarker discovery and patient stratification.

  • Good knowledge about molecular and cellular biology, especially related to cancer and/or other human diseases, to help interpret analyzis results together with our biomedical experts.

  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts and toolkits such as: cross validation, statistical tests, scikit learn, xgboost, etc.

  • Experience using autonomous AI agents and agentic workflows to perform data analyses.

  • Good programming skills in Python.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

 

Ways to Stand Out

The following experience is not necessarily required, but would be a plus:

  • Single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomic data analysis.

  • Clinical and biomedical imaging data.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems and their development.

  • History of publications or contributions to top-tier academic journals or conferences.

  • Have previously worked in a biotech / pharma / life science company.

 

 #LI-HB1

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn and Job Teaser, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)
description: About the team The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior. This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows. Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work. In this role, you will: Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software. Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption. Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability. Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform. Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value. Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved. Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools. Are an active user of Codex or other AI coding tools, with a thoughtful perspective on how they can improve software development. Are a compelling communicator who enjoys presenting, delivering live demos, and leading hands-on workshops for developers and founders. Have a talent for turning complex technical ideas into clear explanations, engaging examples, and reusable resources that help others succeed. Combine developer empathy with sound technical judgment: you can uncover what a team needs, troubleshoot problems, and help them adopt effective, reliable workflows. Bring high agency, curiosity, and end-to-end ownership, working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues and ecosystem partners. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 The Offer Area

We’re the engine that decides what Alan sells, at what price, and on what terms.

Every Alan member, from a 3-person startup to a public administration body with 200K+ collaborators is covered by an offer that our area designed, priced, contracted and renews every year.

We own the whole offer lifecycle for several kind of services (health insurance, life & disability insurance, employee benefits) across 4 countries. We manage an incredible business complexity and diversity in a scalable way, and most importantly, we empower others to act autonomously on it:

  • Offer creation: Enabling Sales to build compliant and relevant offers themselves in minutes, with a real-time pricer and AI assistance, without waiting days for an actuary.

  • Contract Lifecycle: Not only signing a contract in one go and writing the settings that become the source of truth for the rest of Alan, but also providing Business Ops with the tools they need to pilot over the years a portfolio of 100K+ contracts

  • Enabling growth: We’re at the root of Alan’s Insurance stack. Our technical decisions have a long reach: Claims, Billing and many other teams depends on us. We are key to lift blockers and enable the opening of new segments or markets.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

  • 🌍 One insurance stack for every country. We're replacing country-by-country code with a shared "Core Stack": one set of shared rules, with room for local differences. Spain already runs on it, and we’re now tackling France. The architecture decisions you make will shape how Alan sells insurance for the next 10 years. (How we made our offer builder global)

  • 🤖 AI-native underwriting. Insurance is complex, and most insurers need actuaries on every quote. We empower our Sales to build compliant and relevant offers themselves in minutes. AI-assisted smart alternatives, price explanations, pitching and more are already in the Sales hands, and there’s much more to build.

  • 🛡️ Life & Disability as a first-class product: We’re bringing this historically smaller product at Alan to the same level of maturity as Health, with first class member XP, Ops and enabling access to a much wider population.

  • 🧑‍🚀 A growing team. You'll hire it, shape it, and decide what it works on. Talent density, onboarding, feedback, and the mix of skills the area needs are yours to own.

  • 🛡️ Technical direction and operational excellence. Architecture calls, quality standards and shaping the organization and incident response as we scale to more countries. And you stay hands-on: at Alan, engineering leaders are expected to build.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth, engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Your users sit next to you: Hundred of Alaners use what your team ships every day. The feedback loop between building and impact is very short, which allows you to iterate and move quickly.

  • Complex domain, simple software: Regulated domain, many countries, many segments… The job is to model a messy real world into a stack that stays simple and easy to extend.

  • Direct business impact. We own pricing, contract lifecycle and Sales tooling. We have a direct impact on Alan’s margin and growth.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

Reporting to the RTR Director based in Paris, you will be responsible for a range of General Accounting activities for Contentsquare SAS, the Group's largest entity and headquarters, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and completeness of the financial statements in accordance with IFRS and French GAAP.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join Vibe's Talent Acquisition team inside the People org, initially reporting directly to Nicholas Wagner, Chief People Officer. The team owns hiring across Vibe as it pushes toward its 2030 growth targets, and this role is being created to give that effort an extra dedicated pair of hands in Paris. You'll get real ownership from day one: full-cycle recruiting on technical roles, direct partnership with hiring managers, and a seat at the table as the team builds. If you want to grow into a senior technical recruiter inside a team that still feels small enough for your work to be visible, this is a good place to do it.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Engineering and Product roles, from intake to offer.

  • Build sourcing pipelines for specialized technical profiles, including Data and ML roles.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements before opening a search.

  • Run structured candidate conversations that give hiring managers real signal.

  • Keep candidates informed and engaged at every stage of the process.

  • Track pipeline health and flag bottlenecks before they slow a search down.

  • Represent Vibe's culture and mission to candidates considering multiple offers.

     

What You Need

  • 3+ years of experience running full-cycle technical recruiting in a fast-growing company.

  • You've built candidate pipelines for specialized or hard-to-fill technical roles.

  • You've managed a hiring process end to end, from outreach through offer.

  • You communicate clearly with both candidates and engineering hiring managers.

     

Nice to Haves

  • Experience recruiting in the streaming TV advertising or connected TV (CTV) space.

  • A network within the Paris or broader European tech ecosystem.

  • Proven experience on Ashby ATS.

     

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

 

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

 

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  • Live technical discussion — 60 min. A real Vibe search, worked through live with us: search strategy, candidate calibration, pipeline diagnosis. No take-home, no homework.

  • Engineering partner interview — 30 min. A live role intake with one of our engineering leaders.

  • Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  • Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

     

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

title: Thruster CAD and Stress Analyst
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours. We want you as a talented CAD & Stress Analyst to help us in our mission by designing and structurally justifying the hardware that makes up our propulsion systems, with a particular focus on the Thrust Chamber Assembly(TCA). You will own parts from initial CAD layout through to final stress justification, working hand in hand with the manufacturing and test teams to bring flight hardware from concept to qualified design. Key responsibilities In your capacity as a CAD & Stress Analyst, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design and structural justification of propulsion hardware, with the TCA as your primary scope. Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include: During the Design Phase: Design the thrust chamber & injector propulsion hardware in CAD, from concept layout through to detailed design. Perform stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) on designed parts to substantiate margins of safety under mechanical, thermal and pressure loads. Select materials and define manufacturing processes in coordination with manufacturing engineering, accounting for structural, thermal and producibility constraints. Work closely with propulsion, thermal and fluidic system engineers to translate functional requirements into part-level design and load cases. Establish and maintain interface definitions, drawings and part datasets, ensuring configuration control and traceability. Conduct trade studies on design options (geometry, material, manufacturing route) and justify design decisions with analysis. Elaborate and maintain structural analysis reports supporting design reviews and qualification. Support the definition of test requirements needed to validate analytical models and structural assumptions. Produce and maintain technical documentation of design choices and trade-offs, to a high standard, capturing analysis methods and results as to serve as reference justification for the design. During Manufacturing, Assembly and Test Phase: Support manufacturing and inspection of parts, resolving design or tolerance issues as they arise. Support root-cause investigations of any structural anomaly or test finding, correlating analysis with hardware behaviour. Update and correlate stress models and analyses based on test and inspection results. Support design iterations and upgrades based on test campaign outcomes. What we would love to see from you A minimum of a bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering or similar degrees. Over 1 year of related experience in CAD design and stress analysis of mechanical or structural hardware, ideally in a propulsion, aerospace or high-reliability environment. Strong CAD skills, able to take a part from concept to a fully detailed, manufacturable design. Solid grounding in structural/stress analysis, including hand calculations and FEA (e.g. Ansys, Abaqus, or equivalent). Familiarity with manufacturing processes (machining, additive manufacturing, welding/brazing) and their impact on design and structural performance. Nice to have: CFD experience, for thermal or flow-related analysis of propulsion hardware. Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across departments. Fluency in English. Skills and Behaviours Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong analysis and problem-solving skills. Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks. Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done. Ability to communicate at all levels of the business. Demonstrates behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork. Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: We're hiring for Self-Managed Experience (SMX) — the team responsible for making Camunda 8 deployable in a self-service way for customers who run their own infrastructure. SMX covers two areas of work: installation artifacts (Helm chart, Docker Compose, C8Run) and reference architectures & cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure). This role sits primarily on the installation artifacts side — building, maintaining, and releasing the artifacts that ship Camunda 8 to every self-managed customer. You'll be fully embedded in that area day-to-day, but you'll work alongside the reference-architecture side of the team regularly, and SMX is actively working toward enabling every engineer to review and contribute across both stacks over time. SMX is also shifting from a purely artifact- and ops-focused team toward one in which engineers bring customer judgment and product sense alongside technical depth. That means engaging directly with the teams closest to customers — Support, Consulting, Presales — and using that signal to help shape what we prioritize, not just executing a fully-specced ticket. What success looks like (first ~3 months): Taken on your first medic rotation slot and support tickets to understand the stack, customer challenges, and deployment environments. Improved onboarding or documentation, turning your own ramp-up experience into concrete improvements. Contributed to artifact fixes, CI/CD enhancements, or test automation that strengthens release quality. Deliver structural improvement initiatives — a feature request, or a test/release improvement. Built working relationships with engineering, QA, and product peers, and started building context on the reference-architecture side of the team. Started forming your own view of a customer pain point from firsthand signal (support tickets, consulting feedback), not just from a ticket description. Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining Helm Charts; deploying applications on Kubernetes; implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform). Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively across teams. A pragmatic and autonomous approach to programming and problem-solving. You thrive as a manager of one — you build it, you own it — and take pride in delivering maintainable, operable software. Nice-to-haves: Experience running and operating on-prem/self-hosted software on Docker. Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tools. Working knowledge of the Go programming language. Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

Job title: Advanced R&D - Physical Design Engineer

Location : Lausanne, Switzerland

The Physical Design (PD) Engineer translates high-speed communication IP digital designs into physical GDSII layouts for advanced FinFET nodes. You will bridge logic design, owning block-to-chip implementation from netlist to final physical sign-off, ensuring PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) targets are met.

 

Immediate key objective

  • Drive block-level physical implementation—covering synthesis, SDC constraints, floorplanning, placement, CTS, and routing—meeting strict frequency, area, and power targets.

  • Execute timing closure across multiple corners and modes (MCMM) utilizing static timing analysis (STA) and generating targeted ECOs.

  • Drive full physical verification closure sign-off in deep-submicron FinFET technologies.

Responsibility

  • Own block synthesis, floorplanning, placement optimization, CTS, and routing.

  • Develop and refine SDC constraints to ensure design intent matches physical realization.

  • Collaborate with the digital design team to resolve logic or architectural bottlenecks affecting P&R convergence.

  • Generate progress reports, document implementation flows, and prepare sign-off packages for tape-out.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on physical design experience focusing on synthesis, SDC constraints, CTS, and place and route for high-speed systems.

  • Strong technical background in deep-submicron CMOS/FinFET physical effects, crosstalk, and high-frequency clock network design.

  • Proven experience of taking complex blocks from netlist through successful physical implementation.

  • Direct experience with advanced low-power implementation techniques (UPF, power gating).

  • Proven tape-out experience in advanced FinFET nodes (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, or 3nm).

  • Experience handling complex block-to-chip hierarchical assembly, pin placement, and top-level routing constraints..

Required Skills

  • Expert proficiency with industry-standard implementation and sign-off tools (e.g., Cadence Genus/Innovus/Tempus or Synopsys Design Compiler/ICC2/PrimeTime, and Calibre).

  • Deep understanding of SDC creation, and MCMM timing management.

  • Strong scripting skills (Tcl, Python) for flow automation and design data analysis.

  • Analytical mindset to debug congestion routing issues, and complex timing violations.

  • Self-motivated with strong sense of ownership; effective communicator and team player

Required Education

  • Masters or Ph.D. in E.E., Communications or other relevant fields

Today we have one internship position available for max 6 months, in our Advanced R&D, for MSc students in the following area : Analog Design Intern Internship Background Modern computing systems increasingly rely on high-speed serial interfaces to transfer large volumes of data between processors, memory devices, and accelerator chips. Simultaneous bidirectional (SBD) signalling enables both ends of a copper channel to transmit and receive data concurrently over the same physical medium, offering a promising path toward higher bandwidth efficiency without increasing the number of interconnects. Project Objectives The objective of this internship is to investigate circuit and signal-processing techniques that enable simultaneous bidirectional communication over wideband copper serial links. The student will explore methods for separating the locally transmitted signal from the incoming signal while maintaining high data rates and robust link performance. Specific goals may include: Reviewing the state of the art in simultaneous bidirectional and full-duplex wireline communication systems; Developing behavioural models of wideband copper channels and transceiver architectures; Studying self-interference cancellation techniques in the analog and/or digital domains; Evaluating the impact of channel impairments, mismatch, and non-idealities on link performance; Designing and simulating key building blocks using Python or circuit-level CAD tools; Assessing achievable data rates, energy efficiency, and implementation complexity. Expected Outcomes At the end of the internship, the student is expected to: Gain hands-on experience in the design and analysis of high-speed wireline communication systems; Develop simulation models for simultaneous bidirectional serial links; Quantify the benefits and challenges associated with full-duplex operation over copper channels; Present the obtained results in a technical report and oral presentation. Depending on the progress and interests of the student, the work may lead to conference or journal publication opportunities. Desired Background The project is suitable for motivated Master's students in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Communications Engineering, or Computer Engineering. Preferred qualifications: Good level of familiarity with analog IC design and layout drawing; Familiar with analog circuit simulators (SPICE/SPECTRE); Strong background in signal processing; Strong communication and presentation skills. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly. Responsibilities Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms. High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity. Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour. Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication. Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs. Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification. Candidate requirements Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production. Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour. Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium). Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification. Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs. Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production. Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages. We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role

You will drive our next-gen robotic actuators from prototyping to manufacturing and characterization, working together with our team to turn real-world insights and design feedback into the next evolution of robotic actuation. You'll be hands-on, developing test setups and process improvements, turning ideas into working systems fast.

  • Motor Test & Characterization: You will design and build our actuator test setups and rigs, and characterize motor performance: parameters, torque-ripple, cogging, efficiency, and thermal behavior, for our actuators.

  • Quality & Reliability: You will own motor quality and reliability: FMEA, and life and thermal-cycle testing to prove our actuators survive real use.

  • Root-Cause Analysis & Improvement: You will investigate failures and performance drift, drive corrective actions, and feed findings back into our design and production process.

  • Data, Reporting & Acceptance Criteria: You will run systematic data collection and technical reporting, and define the acceptance criteria and KPIs that gate every unit we ship.

What We're Looking For

  • Degree (BSc/MSc) in mechanical, mechatronic, or electrical engineering/equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Experience in testing, characterization, or quality and reliability engineering.

  • Hands-on design and build of test rigs: torque sensors and load cells, dynamometers, encoders, thermocouples etc.

  • Fluency with measurement uncertainty and setup calibration

  • A rigorous, data-driven approach to root-cause analysis and improving both product and process.

  • Strong CAD skills for fixtures and test hardware.

  • Language: We are an international team, fluency in English is a must have.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Supplier quality experience: incoming inspection

  • Familiarity with motor control, motor drives and current sensing

  • Familiarity with high degree of freedom robotic systems

  • Applied statistics in production context

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation
